messages:
maria: Heads-up: I'm planning a night run to repro the weird KV hit-rate dip we saw on node-e last Friday. Want to test locality/fragmentation effects. Thinking 2h run around 02:00 UTC, cohorts randomized, prefetch disabled. Who can kick it off and watch logs?
raj: I can start it. Which bench binary and exact flags should I use?
maria: Use perf/kv_bench v2.3 (the one with new cohort shuffler). Suggested flags: 
```
--duration=7200 --cohorts=50 --seq-dist=prod --prefetch=false --workers=8 --trace=kv:info --emit-metrics=prom --pprof=true
```
Also enable slot/frag sampling: `--frag-sample=2000`. Config PR: https://git.redwood/infra/kv-bench/compare/frag-repro (comments in the PR explain the `seq-dist` override).
alex: 02:15 UTC would be easier for me (later deploy window). If we start at 02:00 some infra cron might overlap. Can we do 02:15?
sophie: Add metric hooks for: prefix_frag_count, eviction_events, kv_alloc_bytes, kv_hitrate. Also grab a periodic `kv:heap` pprof snapshot at 30m and 90m. If hit-rate drops, we should capture a KV dump: `kv-tool dump --hotset=sample`
maria: Good call. Change window to 02:15 then. bench-bot, can you schedule with those flags on node-e (gpu-pool-3)? Tagging @raj to start and @alex to watch dashboards.
bench-bot: Scheduled job 38721 on node-e (gpu-pool-3) -> start 2060000100 (02:15 UTC). Command stored. Owner: raj. ETA: approx 2h.
raj: I'll be live for the start and will tail logs under /var/log/kv/bench.log. If I see any segfaults or OOMs I'll paste snippets here. I'll also keep `sudo perf top` up in case of CPU hotspots.
alex: I'll create a minimal Grafana panel now and add a temporary alert: `kv_hitrate` < 0.52 for >5m -> ping #eng-runtime and DM me. Will post dashboard link here before start.
sophie: For postmortem purposes please capture the exact git commit hashes for runtime and bench: `runtime@` and `kv_bench@`. Also set `--seed=42` in one run variant so we can get deterministic cohort ordering in repro attempts.
maria: If this reproduces we'll: 1) collect kv-dump + pprof + bench logs, 2) run a short isolate on a replica with `--compact=off` to check fragmentation effect, 3) open a tiny repro test and a perf regression PR.
raj: Quick note on the startup command I will run: 
```sh
git checkout refs/heads/frag-repro && ./perf/kv_bench \ 
  --duration=7200 --cohorts=50 --seq-dist=prod --prefetch=false \ 
  --workers=8 --trace=kv:info --emit-metrics=prom --pprof=true --frag-sample=2000 --seed=42
```
I'll paste stdout tail into this thread if anything weird happens.
bench-bot: Reminder: Job 38721 will start in ~10m.
maria: Thanks all. If you can't make the live window, please add a delegate in the thread. Otherwise I'll collate results and assign the follow-up fixes. :thumbsup: 
sophie: I'm on postmortem write-up if we get a repro. Please include the Grafana link and job id in the ticket.
alex: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/kv/frag-repro?panelId=2 (temporary, I added alert rule).
bench-bot: Job 38721 started at 2060000100, stdout redirected to /var/log/kv/bench-38721.log
raj: 02:27 UTC - seeing a gradual hit-rate decline on shard 5, pushing raw log tail: 
```
[02:27:11] shard=5 hit_rate=0.86 -> 0.62 over 9m
[02:30:05] eviction_events=348 active_fragments=1294
[02:32:44] prefix_frag_count=1189 slot_realloc=high
```
maria: Good capture — keep snapshots and do `kv-tool dump --hotset=sample --out=/tmp/hot-dump-38721.tar`. If we confirm fragmentation correlation we'll try the `--compact=off` isolate next.
alex: Alert fired at 02:32, pinged me and eng-runtime. I'll keep the alert active for the remainder of the run.
sophie: Copying these logs into the ticket when available. If anyone gets a heap pprof, please upload link.
raj: Uploading /var/log/kv/bench-38721.log -> https://artifacts.redwood/bench/38721/bench.log
maria: Closing loop — thanks for the quick responses. We'll reconvene async tomorrow with the artifacts and a short decision note.
